title: Scripture and Wisdom
definition: Scripture and wisdom belong together because God's Word teaches His people to fear the Lord, discern truth, and walk faithfully in daily life.
summary: Biblical wisdom is not cleverness detached from God; it is skillful living under the authority of His Word.
christFocus: Christ is the wisdom of God, and Scripture leads believers to walk in Him with humility and discernment.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Scripture and Wisdom teaches that God's people must receive this truth under the authority of the Lord, allowing Scripture itself to define the doctrine rather than personal opinion, tradition, or culture.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it protects the believer from confusion and helps the church remain anchored in what God has actually spoken. Without this truth, faith can drift toward feelings, assumptions, or human wisdom.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: A disciple should respond to scripture and wisdom by reading the Word prayerfully, testing beliefs by Scripture, obeying what God reveals, and helping others handle the Bible with humility, clarity, and faith.

studySections.heading: Guardrails and Common Errors
studySections.content: This doctrine should not be used to win arguments while neglecting love, nor should it be separated from prayer, obedience, and dependence on the Holy Spirit. The goal is faithful submission to God, not mere possession of information.

sources: Scripture references listed in this doctrine entry.
